title: Founder Runtime Approval Application Authority Grant Boundary
objective: Define the governed approval application authority grant boundary before any live authority grant can be considered, while keeping grants, approval application, DB/runtime writes, execution, provider calls, project mutation, deploy, package, network, and spend blocked.
safetyRules: Do not enable approval application authority grant in P124.1.
Do not enable approval application, approval capture, approval persistence, or approve/reject decision recording in P124.1.
Do not enable DB writes, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, runtime writes, runtime execution, or execution unlock in P124.1.
Do not call providers/models, dispatch agents, execute workers/tools, mutate projects, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend in P124.1.
Do not change Command Center source or dashboard tests in P124.1.
Do not expose DemoApp, raw JSON/log/policy dumps, raw private IDs, raw DB names, raw report paths in primary UX, fake runnable actions, or mutation controls.
Future P124 subphases must define narrow authority, validation, UX, rollback, and explicit operator evidence before any later phase can consider live behavior.
knownLimitations: P124.1 is contract/policy only and does not grant live authority.
P124.2 is metadata-only and does not grant live authority.
P124.3 is model-only and does not grant live authority.
P124.4 is dry-run preview only and does not grant live authority.
P124.5 is scoped Command Center display-only UX and does not grant live authority.
P124.6 is validation/docs closure only and does not grant live authority.
P124.7 is final validation only and does not grant live authority.

Approval application authority grant, activation, approval application, approval capture, approval persistence, approve/reject decision recording, DB/runtime writes, runtime execution, execution unlock, provider/model calls, agent dispatch, worker/tool execution, project mutation, hosted DB mutation, raw SQL, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, and provider spend remain blocked.
